indicator_name: Bank loans to the economy, principal outstanding at the start of the month, by purpose and borrower (incl. housing, overdue)
description: Кредиты банковского сектора экономике, основной долг на начало месяца, по целям кредитования и заёмщикам (в т.ч. на жильё, просроченный)
unit: million KZT, at the start of the month
methodology: NBK formId=488 (see LOANS_STOCK_BY_INDUSTRY). Items: BUS, HH; <BUS|HH>.<purpose>; <purpose>; <BUS|HH>.<purpose>.OVERDUE; <BUS|HH>.<KZT|FX>. HH.HOUSING = loans to individuals for construction and purchase of housing (the mortgage-type portfolio): 8 195.6 bn KZT at 2026-09-01, HH.CONSUMER 17 639.2 bn, TOTAL 46 115.1 bn (banks and the rest of the banking sector). Report dates from 2026-05-01 fetched; earlier values kept from the archive.
